Get the battery pack (14 kg) over to pump house - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
The valve at pump house needs tightening - that takes 4.5 minutes on site but only once the pressure gauge (T15) has arrived.
Pick up a soil sample at south yard and keep it on board; it weighs 2 kg - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
Get the toolkit (11 kg) over to south yard - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 5 minutes.
Pump house needs the pressure gauge, which weighs 13 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
Have a look at office roof - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
